/*! \brief [Graph] Creates a layer logsoftmax activation Node.
 * \param [in] graph The handle to the graph.

 * \param [in] axis [static] The axis on which we need to do logsoftmax.
 * \param [in] input The input tensor </tt>.
 * \param [out] output The output tensor data, Output will have the same number of dimension ass input tensor.
 * \return <tt> vx_node</tt>.
 * \returns A node reference <tt>\ref vx_node</tt>. Any possible errors preventing a
 * successful creation should be checked using <tt>\ref vxGetStatus</tt>.
 * \ingroup group_cnn
 */

    vx_graph                    graph,
    vx_tensor                   input,
    vx_float32                  beta,
    vx_int32                    axis,
    vx_tensor                   output
    );
